basis: Exactly two newly prepared broader native crops, visually opened once each with original detail.

observations.visible_same_row_context: 在光谱的黄绿光区域内
observations.glyph_observation: Both target characters are legible as the printed simplified Chinese characters huang and lv; no alternate target glyph is needed.

neighbor_comparison.observed_difference: Huang has broad filled horizontal and upright strokes, and lv has comparably thick strokes in both its left component and right component. The immediately preceding de and following guang/qu/yu/nei have visibly finer horizontal strokes and a lighter text texture. The preceding guangpu in this same row is lighter too. The neighboring row's ordinary prose supplies the same finer-stroke baseline.
neighbor_comparison.limitation: The scan has uneven ink and individual dark strokes elsewhere; the verdict rests on the repeated heavier stroke treatment across both target glyphs, not on overall darkness or stroke count.

observations.conclusion: The native pixels support bold emphasis on both target characters.

observations.visible_same_row_context: 灯的光获得的光谱的不同位置上
observations.glyph_observation: Guang and pu are legible; pu shows its simplified speech radical and the right-hand pu component.

neighbor_comparison.adjacent_row_above_context: 金属片应当放在用棱镜分解弧光
neighbor_comparison.observed_difference: Guang has a broad crossbar and thick lower legs. Pu has broad strokes in its speech radical and upper-right component. The directly adjacent de characters and much of the same-row phrase also have heavy strokes, so this is not an isolated two-character weight change. In the actual row immediately above, the prose around jinshu/pian and yong/lengjing/fenjie has noticeably finer horizontal strokes; its final guang is a direct same-glyph lighter comparator.
neighbor_comparison.limitation: This finding establishes the weight of the two target glyphs only. It does not delimit or approve the extent of the neighboring bold phrase.

observations.conclusion: The native pixels support bold emphasis on both target characters, within a broader locally heavy printed run.
